categories.title: Foundations
categories.description: Setup, routing, plan awareness and data hygiene that every other skill builds on.

skills.name: realmarketapi-skills-catalog
skills.title: Skills Catalog
skills.description: Routes a market question to the right RealMarketAPI skill or sequence of skills. Use first when a request could be served by several skills or when you are unsure which one applies.

skills.name: realmarketapi-quickstart
skills.title: Quickstart
skills.description: Connects an agent to RealMarketAPI over MCP or REST and verifies the connection with a first live call. Use when setting up a new agent, a new API key, or when no RealMarketAPI call has succeeded yet in the session.

skills.name: realmarketapi-plan-and-quota-check
skills.title: Plan and Quota Check
skills.description: Reads the plan, allowed symbols, timeframes, history range and request usage for an API key and adapts the workflow to them. Use before a large batch of calls or when a request is rejected for plan or quota reasons.

skills.name: realmarketapi-symbol-resolver
skills.title: Symbol Resolver
skills.description: Maps everyday instrument names such as gold, bitcoin, cable or the S&P 500 to exact RealMarketAPI symbol codes. Use when the user names an asset in plain language or uses a broker-specific ticker.

skills.name: realmarketapi-timeframe-selector
skills.title: Timeframe Selector
skills.description: Chooses the analysis, execution and trigger timeframes that fit a trading horizon and the timeframes a plan allows. Use when the user gives no timeframe or describes a horizon such as scalp, intraday or swing.

skills.name: realmarketapi-error-recovery
skills.title: Error Recovery
skills.description: Diagnoses failed RealMarketAPI calls from the problem+json body and chooses the right recovery. Use when a call returns a 4xx or 5xx status, an empty data array, or a tool error.

skills.name: realmarketapi-request-budgeting
skills.title: Request Budgeting
skills.description: Plans the smallest set of calls that answers a question and avoids waste on a metered plan. Use before multi-symbol scans, loops, scheduled jobs or any task that could spend more than about twenty requests.

skills.name: realmarketapi-data-freshness-check
skills.title: Data Freshness Check
skills.description: Verifies that returned prices are current by comparing candle timestamps with the clock and the market schedule. Use before quoting a live price, after a weekend or holiday, or when numbers look stale.

skills.name: realmarketapi-answer-guardrails
skills.title: Answer Guardrails
skills.description: Applies a final quality and safety pass to any market answer: sourced numbers, stated uncertainty, risk wording and no promises. Use before sending analysis, signals or trade ideas to an end user.

categories.title: Market Data Analyst
categories.description: Live quotes, snapshots, candles, history and descriptive statistics.

skills.name: realmarketapi-market-context
skills.title: Market Context
skills.description: Builds a quick picture of where a symbol stands right now: last price, 24h baseline, recent candles and position in the day's range. Use first, before deeper technical, risk or decision skills.

skills.name: realmarketapi-live-price-quote
skills.title: Live Price Quote
skills.description: Returns the latest price, bid, ask and spread for one symbol. Use when the user only wants the current price or a quick quote.

skills.name: realmarketapi-market-snapshot
skills.title: Market Snapshot
skills.description: Summarises every symbol on the plan in one call with hourly and daily change. Use when the user asks how the market is doing overall or wants a cross-asset overview.

skills.name: realmarketapi-category-snapshot
skills.title: Category Snapshot
skills.description: Summarises one asset class such as forex, crypto, stocks, indices or commodities. Use when the user asks about a single market segment rather than one symbol or the whole market.

skills.name: realmarketapi-daily-stats-24h
skills.title: 24-Hour Statistics
skills.description: Reports 24-hour open, high, low, volume and percentage change per symbol. Use when the user asks for the day's range, 24h change or 24h volume.

skills.name: realmarketapi-top-movers
skills.title: Top Movers
skills.description: Ranks the biggest gainers and losers over the last 24 hours. Use when the user asks what is moving, what is hot, or wants ideas to look at.

skills.name: realmarketapi-candle-reader
skills.title: Candle Reader
skills.description: Reads recent OHLCV candles and describes price action in plain language. Use when the user asks what price has been doing over the last few bars or sessions.

skills.name: realmarketapi-historical-data-pull
skills.title: Historical Data Pull
skills.description: Downloads paged historical candles for a date range and returns a clean, ordered dataset. Use when the user needs past data for charts, research, backtests or exports.

skills.name: realmarketapi-spread-monitor
skills.title: Spread Monitor
skills.description: Measures the bid-ask spread of a symbol and tells whether it is normal or wide. Use when the user asks about trading cost, liquidity or whether now is a good time to execute.

skills.name: realmarketapi-volume-analysis
skills.title: Volume Analysis
skills.description: Compares current volume with its recent average and relates it to price movement. Use when the user asks whether a move has participation behind it or wants relative volume.

skills.name: realmarketapi-price-change-calculator
skills.title: Price Change Calculator
skills.description: Calculates the absolute and percentage change of a symbol between two points in time. Use when the user asks how much something moved over a period such as this week, this month or since a date.

skills.name: realmarketapi-cross-asset-comparison
skills.title: Cross-Asset Comparison
skills.description: Compares the performance of several symbols over the same window on a normalised basis. Use when the user asks which asset did better or wants to compare instruments side by side.

skills.name: realmarketapi-range-statistics
skills.title: Range Statistics
skills.description: Computes average daily range, typical session range and how much of today's range is already used. Use when the user asks how far a symbol usually moves or whether today's move is stretched.

skills.name: realmarketapi-gap-detector
skills.title: Gap Detector
skills.description: Finds price gaps between one candle's close and the next open, including weekend gaps. Use when the user asks about gaps, weekend opens or unfilled gaps.

categories.title: Technical Analyst
categories.description: Indicator reads, levels, patterns and multi-timeframe alignment.

skills.name: realmarketapi-technical-analysis
skills.title: Technical Analysis
skills.description: Produces a complete technical read of one symbol from trend, momentum, levels and sentiment. Use when the user asks for chart analysis, a technical view or a bias on a symbol.

skills.name: realmarketapi-trend-identification
skills.title: Trend Identification
skills.description: Determines direction and strength of the trend on one timeframe. Use when the user asks whether a symbol is trending, which way, or how strongly.

skills.name: realmarketapi-moving-average-analysis
skills.title: Moving Average Analysis
skills.description: Reads SMA, EMA and WMA values, their slopes, stacking and crossovers. Use when the user asks about moving averages, crossovers or dynamic support and resistance.

skills.name: realmarketapi-rsi-analysis
skills.title: RSI Analysis
skills.description: Interprets the Relative Strength Index for momentum, overbought and oversold conditions and regime. Use when the user asks about RSI or whether a symbol is overbought or oversold.

skills.name: realmarketapi-macd-analysis
skills.title: MACD Analysis
skills.description: Interprets MACD line, signal line and histogram for momentum shifts. Use when the user asks about MACD, momentum turning or a crossover signal.

skills.name: realmarketapi-bollinger-bands-analysis
skills.title: Bollinger Bands Analysis
skills.description: Reads Bollinger Bands for volatility state, squeezes and band position. Use when the user asks about Bollinger Bands, a squeeze or whether price is stretched.

skills.name: realmarketapi-stochastic-analysis
skills.title: Stochastic Analysis
skills.description: Interprets the Stochastic oscillator %K and %D for short-term turning points. Use when the user asks about Stochastic readings or timing inside a range.

skills.name: realmarketapi-adx-trend-strength
skills.title: ADX Trend Strength
skills.description: Measures trend strength and directional dominance with ADX, +DI and -DI. Use when the user asks how strong a trend is or whether to use trend or range tactics.

skills.name: realmarketapi-cci-analysis
skills.title: CCI Analysis
skills.description: Interprets the Commodity Channel Index for momentum bursts and extremes. Use when the user asks about CCI or wants a momentum trigger for commodities and indices.

skills.name: realmarketapi-williams-r-analysis
skills.title: Williams %R Analysis
skills.description: Interprets Williams %R for overbought and oversold timing. Use when the user asks about Williams %R or wants a fast oscillator for entries.

skills.name: realmarketapi-atr-analysis
skills.title: ATR Analysis
skills.description: Reads Average True Range to size expected movement on a timeframe. Use when the user asks how volatile a symbol is in price terms or needs a unit for stops and targets.

skills.name: realmarketapi-fibonacci-levels
skills.title: Fibonacci Levels
skills.description: Retrieves Fibonacci retracement and extension levels for the current swing. Use when the user asks for Fibonacci levels, pullback zones or extension targets.

skills.name: realmarketapi-support-resistance-mapping
skills.title: Support and Resistance Mapping
skills.description: Maps the nearest support and resistance levels around current price and ranks them. Use when the user asks for key levels, where price may react, or where to set alerts.

skills.name: realmarketapi-momentum-oscillator-consensus
skills.title: Momentum Oscillator Consensus
skills.description: Polls RSI, Stochastic, CCI and Williams %R and reports whether they agree. Use when the user asks if a symbol is overbought or oversold and wants more than one oscillator.

skills.name: realmarketapi-divergence-detector
skills.title: Divergence Detector
skills.description: Finds regular and hidden divergence between price swings and RSI or MACD. Use when the user asks about divergence or early signs that a move is weakening.

skills.name: realmarketapi-candlestick-patterns
skills.title: Candlestick Patterns
skills.description: Detects common candlestick patterns in recent closed candles and rates them by location. Use when the user asks about candle patterns or a reversal or continuation signal on the latest bars.

skills.name: realmarketapi-chart-pattern-scout
skills.title: Chart Pattern Scout
skills.description: Looks for classical chart structures such as double tops and bottoms, triangles, flags and head and shoulders in candle data. Use when the user asks whether a chart pattern is forming.

skills.name: realmarketapi-multi-timeframe
skills.title: Multi-Timeframe Analysis
skills.description: Checks trend alignment from the highest to the lowest timeframe in one pass. Use when the user asks for a top-down view or whether timeframes agree.

skills.name: realmarketapi-indicator-confluence
skills.title: Indicator Confluence
skills.description: Scores how many independent technical factors agree on direction. Use when the user asks how strong a setup is or wants a confluence check before acting.

skills.name: realmarketapi-pivot-points
skills.title: Pivot Points
skills.description: Calculates classic daily pivot levels from the previous day's candle. Use when the user asks for pivots, daily levels or intraday reference points.

skills.name: realmarketapi-golden-death-cross
skills.title: Golden and Death Cross
skills.description: Checks the 50 and 200 period SMA relationship on the daily chart. Use when the user asks about a golden cross, a death cross or the long-term trend filter.

categories.title: Risk and Volatility Manager
categories.description: Volatility regimes, position sizing, stops, targets and portfolio risk.

skills.name: realmarketapi-volatility-regime
skills.title: Volatility Regime
skills.description: Classifies current volatility as low, normal or high from ATR percent and Bollinger width. Use when the user asks how volatile a symbol is or before choosing stop distance and position size.

skills.name: realmarketapi-volatility-spike-alert
skills.title: Volatility Spike Detection
skills.description: Finds candles where ATR spiked above a multiple of its norm. Use when the user asks whether there was a volatility shock or wants to review abnormal bars.

skills.name: realmarketapi-volatility-heatmap-timing
skills.title: Volatility Heatmap Timing
skills.description: Uses the day-of-week by hour-of-day volatility heatmap to find the most and least active trading windows. Use when the user asks when a symbol moves most or when to schedule trading.

skills.name: realmarketapi-position-sizing
skills.title: Position Sizing
skills.description: Calculates position size from account balance, risk percentage and stop distance. Use when the user asks how much to trade or how many lots, units or shares to take.

skills.name: realmarketapi-stop-loss-placement
skills.title: Stop-Loss Placement
skills.description: Proposes a stop-loss level from structure, volatility and known stop-hunt zones. Use when the user has an entry idea and asks where the stop should go.

skills.name: realmarketapi-take-profit-targets
skills.title: Take-Profit Targets
skills.description: Sets profit targets from opposing structure, Fibonacci extensions and liquidity zones. Use when the user asks where to take profit or how to scale out.

skills.name: realmarketapi-risk-reward-evaluator
skills.title: Risk-Reward Evaluator
skills.description: Computes reward-to-risk for a proposed entry, stop and target and the win rate needed to break even. Use when the user gives trade levels and asks whether the trade is worth taking.

skills.name: realmarketapi-trade-risk-check
skills.title: Pre-Trade Risk Check
skills.description: Runs a pre-trade checklist across manipulation risk, anomalies, volatility and scheduled events. Use immediately before entering a trade or approving a signal.

skills.name: realmarketapi-drawdown-analysis
skills.title: Drawdown Analysis
skills.description: Measures maximum drawdown, current drawdown and recovery time of a symbol or an equity series. Use when the user asks how bad the worst decline was or how deep the current pullback is.

skills.name: realmarketapi-correlation-matrix
skills.title: Correlation Matrix
skills.description: Computes return correlations between symbols over a chosen window. Use when the user asks whether assets move together or wants to avoid doubling the same exposure.

skills.name: realmarketapi-portfolio-exposure
skills.title: Portfolio Exposure
skills.description: Aggregates open positions into net exposure by currency, asset class and direction. Use when the user lists positions and asks about concentration or total risk.

skills.name: realmarketapi-value-at-risk
skills.title: Value at Risk
skills.description: Estimates historical one-day value at risk and expected shortfall for a position or small portfolio. Use when the user asks how much could be lost on a bad day.

skills.name: realmarketapi-margin-and-leverage
skills.title: Margin and Leverage
skills.description: Calculates required margin, effective leverage and distance to a margin call for a position. Use when the user asks about margin, leverage or how much room a position has.

skills.name: realmarketapi-trailing-stop-manager
skills.title: Trailing Stop Manager
skills.description: Proposes trailing-stop updates for an open position using ATR and structure. Use when the user is in a profitable trade and asks how to trail the stop.

categories.title: Market Structure Analyst
categories.description: Liquidity, stop hunts, order flow, anomalies and smart-money concepts.

skills.name: realmarketapi-liquidity-zones
skills.title: Liquidity Zones
skills.description: Maps clusters of resting liquidity above and below price. Use when the user asks where liquidity sits, where price is likely to be drawn, or for liquidity-based targets.

skills.name: realmarketapi-stop-hunt-zones
skills.title: Stop-Hunt Zones
skills.description: Identifies areas beyond key levels where stop orders are likely clustered and exposed to a sweep. Use when the user asks about stop hunts, fake-outs or safe stop placement.

skills.name: realmarketapi-orderflow-imbalance
skills.title: Order Flow Imbalance
skills.description: Reads bullish versus bearish candle dominance and imbalance zones. Use when the user asks who is in control, buyers or sellers, or wants order-flow confirmation.

skills.name: realmarketapi-anomaly-detection
skills.title: Anomaly Detection
skills.description: Flags sudden price spikes and unusual volume in recent candles. Use when the user asks what just happened, whether a move is abnormal, or as a safety check.

skills.name: realmarketapi-manipulation-risk
skills.title: Manipulation Risk
skills.description: Reports the current manipulation risk level for a symbol and what drives it. Use when the user asks whether price action is trustworthy or before trading thin conditions.

skills.name: realmarketapi-market-structure-bos
skills.title: Market Structure: BOS and CHoCH
skills.description: Labels swing structure, breaks of structure and changes of character from candle data. Use when the user asks about market structure, BOS, CHoCH or higher highs and lower lows.

skills.name: realmarketapi-fair-value-gaps
skills.title: Fair Value Gaps
skills.description: Finds three-candle price imbalances that have not been filled. Use when the user asks about fair value gaps, FVGs or imbalance entries.

skills.name: realmarketapi-order-blocks
skills.title: Order Blocks
skills.description: Locates the last opposing candle before a strong displacement move as a potential reaction zone. Use when the user asks about order blocks or institutional entry zones.

skills.name: realmarketapi-liquidity-sweep-setup
skills.title: Liquidity Sweep Setup
skills.description: Detects a sweep of a stop-hunt zone followed by a reclaim of the level. Use when the user asks about a sweep entry, a fake breakout or a stop-run reversal.

skills.name: realmarketapi-smart-money-narrative
skills.title: Smart Money Narrative
skills.description: Combines structure, liquidity, imbalances and order flow into one coherent story of what price is doing and where it is drawn next. Use when the user asks for an ICT or SMC style read.

categories.title: Signal and Insight Analyst
categories.description: Composite scores, setups, next-candle bias, sentiment and final decisions.

skills.name: realmarketapi-insight-score
skills.title: Insight Score
skills.description: Reads the composite bullish or bearish score from 0 to 100 for a symbol. Use when the user wants one number for how bullish or bearish something is.

skills.name: realmarketapi-insight-trend
skills.title: Insight Trend
skills.description: Returns the classified trend direction from StrongUptrend to StrongDowntrend. Use when the user wants a quick trend label without computing indicators.

skills.name: realmarketapi-insight-setup
skills.title: Insight Setup
skills.description: Identifies the current setup type as Breakout, Pullback or Range. Use when the user asks what kind of setup is on the chart or which playbook applies.

skills.name: realmarketapi-insight-next-candle
skills.title: Next-Candle Bias
skills.description: Reads the next-candle directional bias with its supporting indicators and levels. Use when the user asks what the next bar is likely to do or wants a short-horizon read.

skills.name: realmarketapi-insight-confluence
skills.title: Insight Confluence
skills.description: Returns the combined Buy, Sell or Neutral signal from all insight components. Use when the user wants a single consolidated signal for a symbol and timeframe.

skills.name: realmarketapi-strategy-signal
skills.title: Strategy Signal
skills.description: Retrieves the Signal Lab strategy signal with confidence, risk level, invalidation price and reasons. Use when the user asks for a ready-made trade signal with a defined invalidation.

skills.name: realmarketapi-sentiment-analysis
skills.title: Sentiment Analysis
skills.description: Reads trend direction, market sentiment and the Fear and Greed score for a symbol. Use when the user asks about sentiment, fear and greed, or wants to confirm or challenge a technical view.

skills.name: realmarketapi-signal-validation
skills.title: Signal Validation
skills.description: Cross-checks a trade signal from any source against independent data and risk conditions. Use when the user brings a signal or an idea and asks whether it holds up.

skills.name: realmarketapi-trading-decision
skills.title: Trading Decision
skills.description: Turns context, analysis and risk into a final bias with entry zone, invalidation, targets and confidence. Use at the end of an analysis chain when the user asks what to do.

categories.title: Trader
categories.description: Style playbooks, rule-based strategies, trade plans, management and journaling.

skills.name: realmarketapi-scalping-playbook
skills.title: Scalping Playbook
skills.description: Runs a scalping routine on M1 and M5 with M15 context, tight risk and session filters. Use when the user wants very short-term trades lasting minutes.

skills.name: realmarketapi-day-trading-playbook
skills.title: Day Trading Playbook
skills.description: Runs an intraday routine with H4 bias, H1 structure and M15 entries, flat by the end of the session. Use when the user wants trades opened and closed within the day.

skills.name: realmarketapi-swing-trading-playbook
skills.title: Swing Trading Playbook
skills.description: Runs a multi-day routine with D1 trend, H4 setups and H1 timing. Use when the user wants trades held for days to a few weeks.

skills.name: realmarketapi-position-trading-playbook
skills.title: Position Trading Playbook
skills.description: Runs a long-horizon routine on the daily chart using the 50 and 200 period averages. Use when the user wants trades held for weeks to months.

skills.name: realmarketapi-breakout-strategy
skills.title: Breakout Strategy
skills.description: Trades a confirmed break of a well-tested level with volatility expansion. Use when price is compressing under resistance or above support and the user asks about a breakout.

skills.name: realmarketapi-pullback-strategy
skills.title: Pullback Strategy
skills.description: Enters an established trend on a retracement to value. Use when a symbol is trending and the user asks where to join it.

skills.name: realmarketapi-range-trading-strategy
skills.title: Range Trading Strategy
skills.description: Fades the edges of a defined range while trend strength is low. Use when a symbol is moving sideways and the user asks how to trade it.

skills.name: realmarketapi-mean-reversion-strategy
skills.title: Mean Reversion Strategy
skills.description: Trades a return to the mean after a statistical stretch from Bollinger Bands and RSI. Use when the user asks whether a move is overextended enough to fade.

skills.name: realmarketapi-trend-following-strategy
skills.title: Trend Following Strategy
skills.description: Rides established trends with moving-average alignment and an ATR trailing stop. Use when the user wants a systematic way to stay with a trend.

skills.name: realmarketapi-momentum-strategy
skills.title: Momentum Strategy
skills.description: Buys strength and sells weakness when momentum, trend strength and order flow agree. Use when the user asks about a fast move and whether to trade in its direction.

skills.name: realmarketapi-ema-crossover-strategy
skills.title: EMA Crossover Strategy
skills.description: Trades the cross of a fast and slow EMA with a trend-strength filter. Use when the user asks for a simple rule-based crossover system.

skills.name: realmarketapi-rsi-reversal-strategy
skills.title: RSI Reversal Strategy
skills.description: Trades reversals from RSI extremes that are backed by divergence and a level. Use when the user asks for an oversold bounce or overbought fade with rules.

skills.name: realmarketapi-bollinger-squeeze-strategy
skills.title: Bollinger Squeeze Strategy
skills.description: Trades the volatility expansion that follows a Bollinger Band squeeze. Use when bands are unusually narrow and the user asks how to position for the move.

skills.name: realmarketapi-news-event-strategy
skills.title: News Event Strategy
skills.description: Plans around a scheduled high-impact event: stand aside, trade the reaction, or trade the retrace. Use when a major release is due and the user asks how to handle it.

skills.name: realmarketapi-trade-plan-builder
skills.title: Trade Plan Builder
skills.description: Writes a complete trade plan with thesis, entry, stop, targets, size and management rules. Use when the user has a direction in mind and wants a plan they can follow.

skills.name: realmarketapi-trade-management
skills.title: Trade Management
skills.description: Reviews an open position against live data and recommends hold, reduce, trail or exit. Use when the user is in a trade and asks what to do now.

skills.name: realmarketapi-trade-journal
skills.title: Trade Journal
skills.description: Records trades with market conditions at entry and reviews them for patterns. Use when the user wants to log a trade or review past performance.

categories.title: Asset Specialists
categories.description: Instrument-specific behaviour for metals, forex, crypto, energy, indices and stocks.

skills.name: realmarketapi-xauusd-specialist
skills.title: XAUUSD Gold Specialist
skills.description: Analyses gold with its own habits in mind: session behaviour, round numbers, dollar linkage and liquidity sweeps. Use when the symbol is XAUUSD or the user asks about gold.

skills.name: realmarketapi-silver-specialist
skills.title: XAGUSD Silver Specialist
skills.description: Analyses silver and its relationship to gold through the gold-silver ratio. Use when the symbol is XAGUSD or the user asks about silver or the ratio.

skills.name: realmarketapi-forex-majors-specialist
skills.title: Forex Majors Specialist
skills.description: Analyses EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, AUDUSD, USDCAD and NZDUSD with the dollar as the common driver. Use when the user asks about a major pair or the major pairs as a group.

skills.name: realmarketapi-jpy-pairs-specialist
skills.title: JPY Pairs Specialist
skills.description: Analyses USDJPY and GBPJPY with attention to their volatility, risk sensitivity and sharp reversals. Use when the user asks about yen pairs.

skills.name: realmarketapi-dxy-dollar-analyst
skills.title: Dollar Index Analyst
skills.description: Analyses the US dollar index and what it implies for forex, gold and risk assets. Use when the user asks about the dollar or needs a dollar view before another trade.

skills.name: realmarketapi-bitcoin-specialist
skills.title: Bitcoin Specialist
skills.description: Analyses BTCUSD as a 24/7 market with weekend behaviour, round-number levels and high volatility. Use when the user asks about bitcoin.

skills.name: realmarketapi-altcoin-specialist
skills.title: Ethereum and Altcoin Specialist
skills.description: Analyses ETH, SOL, XRP, BNB, ADA, LINK, DOGE and CAKE relative to bitcoin. Use when the user asks about ethereum or an altcoin.

skills.name: realmarketapi-crypto-market-breadth
skills.title: Crypto Market Breadth
skills.description: Measures how broad a crypto move is across all covered coins. Use when the user asks whether the whole crypto market is moving or only bitcoin.

skills.name: realmarketapi-oil-specialist
skills.title: Crude Oil Specialist
skills.description: Analyses WTI and Brent crude and the spread between them. Use when the user asks about oil, USOIL or UKOIL.

skills.name: realmarketapi-commodities-specialist
skills.title: Commodities Specialist
skills.description: Analyses natural gas, platinum and copper. Use when the user asks about XNGUSD, XPTUSD or XCUUSD.

skills.name: realmarketapi-us-indices-specialist
skills.title: US Indices Specialist
skills.description: Analyses US500, US30 and USTEC together, including leadership between them. Use when the user asks about US stock indices.

skills.name: realmarketapi-global-indices-specialist
skills.title: Global Indices Specialist
skills.description: Analyses European and Asia-Pacific indices: UK100, DE30, FR40, STOXX50, JP225, HK50, AUS200 and IN50. Use when the user asks about a non-US index or the global equity picture.

skills.name: realmarketapi-us-stocks-specialist
skills.title: US Stocks Specialist
skills.description: Analyses covered US stocks such as AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, TSLA, AMZN, GOOGL and META on price data. Use when the user asks for a technical view of a covered stock.

skills.name: realmarketapi-intermarket-analysis
skills.title: Intermarket Analysis
skills.description: Reads the relationships between the dollar, gold, oil, equity indices and bitcoin to judge the macro tone. Use when the user asks what is driving markets or wants cross-market confirmation.

categories.title: Session and Macro Analyst
categories.description: Trading sessions, the economic calendar, event risk and market regime.

skills.name: realmarketapi-market-sessions
skills.title: Market Sessions
skills.description: Reports which trading sessions are open, overlapping or about to open. Use when the user asks what session it is, when a market opens, or how timing affects a trade.

skills.name: realmarketapi-economic-calendar-briefing
skills.title: Economic Calendar Briefing
skills.description: Lists the day's high-impact economic events and the symbols they affect. Use when the user asks what is on the calendar or what could move the market today.

skills.name: realmarketapi-event-risk-filter
skills.title: Event Risk Filter
skills.description: Decides whether a planned trade falls inside a no-trade window around a scheduled event. Use before entering a trade or when scheduling automated strategies.

skills.name: realmarketapi-session-open-playbook
skills.title: Session Open Playbook
skills.description: Trades the break of the prior session's range at the London or New York open. Use when the user asks about an opening-range or session-breakout trade.

skills.name: realmarketapi-risk-sentiment-gauge
skills.title: Risk Sentiment Gauge
skills.description: Scores market-wide risk appetite from indices, the dollar, gold, bitcoin and yen pairs. Use when the user asks whether markets are risk-on or risk-off.

skills.name: realmarketapi-market-regime-classifier
